title: Contracts and hours
description: Monthly agreements, tracked work and period statements.
error: Unable to load this view. Try refreshing.
emptyHint: Create a monthly agreement to start managing included hours.
emptyPortal: Your team will share monthly consumption here.
overageAlert: The included allowance has been exceeded. Review the overage before billing.
consumptionAlert: At least 80% of the available hours have been used.
noEntries: No hours this month yet. Link a project to count new hours automatically, or add earlier hours.
name: Contract name
manualBilling: Prepare a commercial draft on closing
createHint: Enter the monthly fee, included hours and terms agreed with your client.
termsNote: Periods are full calendar months in this time zone, without proration. Terms stay fixed; changes require a replacement contract. Linked recurring invoices keep their existing schedule and own the monthly fee. Select a matching amount and confirm the agreed currency.
confirmTerms: I reviewed the amount, currency, renewal, carry and overage rules.
recurringOwnsFee: Monthly fee handled by the linked recurring invoice
billingNote: Monthly fees and approved extra hours are available in Invoices. Your team reviews them before issuing or sending. Rejected amounts are not charged.
allocateHint: Choose recorded hours to include in this month. Only completed, billable hours not used in another invoice or contract appear.
noEligible: No available time in this period.
removeHint: This releases the time for correction, another contract or standalone invoicing.
adjustHint: Select an entry from a closed period. Enter signed minutes and a client-visible explanation. The adjustment changes this open period only; any credit for previous billing must be reviewed separately.
closeHint: Review all entries before closing. The statement becomes immutable; unallocated time stays outside this contract. Unused hours follow the agreed validity and cap. No invoice is issued by this action.
stateHint: Pause and cancellation stop new consumption and pause linked recurring billing. They do not prorate the current month. Resuming consumption does not resume recurring billing: review its schedule in Invoices before reactivating it. Cancellation is permanent.
confirm: I reviewed and confirm this operation.
saveError: Unable to save. Refresh and review before trying again.
forbidden: You do not have access to contracts.

errors.VERSION_CHANGED: This period changed. Close this dialog and refresh before reviewing again.
errors.TIME_CHANGED: Selected time changed or is already assigned. Refresh the selection.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the required values and commercial rules.
errors.INVALID_ADJUSTMENT: Use a time reference from an earlier closed period. The adjustment cannot make consumption negative.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_ENDED: The period has not ended in its time zone.
errors.ACTIVE_TIMER: Stop the client’s running timer before closing this period.
errors.CLOSE_PREVIOUS: Finish reviewing the previous month first so its remaining hours can be carried over.
errors.CONTRACT_INACTIVE: This operation is unavailable for the contract state or dates.
errors.RECURRING_CHANGED: The recurring template must belong to this client, be monthly and have the same amount.
errors.RECURRING_ASSIGNED: This recurring template already belongs to a contract.
errors.REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request was already used with different values. Close the dialog and review.
errors.PERIOD_CLOSED: The period is closed. Use an adjustment in an open period.
errors.DATA_CHANGED: The data changed. Refresh and review the operation.

noEntriesPortal: Your team has not recorded hours for this contract in the selected month. You do not need to add anything here.
portalGuide: Your team records the hours. You can check the balance here. Any extra charge that needs your approval will appear in your pending items.
autoHoursHint: Choose the projects covered by this contract. New completed, billable hours will appear here automatically. Use “Add earlier hours” for time already recorded.
noProjectsToLink: No other project is available. It must belong to this client, use the same currency and have no other linked contract.
linkError: Could not link this project. Refresh and check whether it already uses another contract.
carryPending: Hours are already being counted for this month. The balance from last month will be updated when your team finishes its review.
monthStillOpen: Keep recording hours. You can review and finish this month after it ends.
readyToClose: The month has ended. Check the hours and finish the review to prepare billing.
readyToBillHint: Agreed or approved amounts. Create a draft to review before sending it to the client.
invoicePrepared: Draft created. Find it in the invoice list below to review. Nothing was sent to the client.
billingError: Could not prepare the invoice. Refresh the list and check whether the amount changed or your plan limit was reached.
portalAccessHint: You can add the client now and give them portal access later.
